title: Prove a complete terminal-band QQ16 cost exclusion
body:
## Result and construction decision

Frozen [PR #4166](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4166) QQ16 D costs **strictly more reads, writes and unit moves** than original-arithmetic B* on a nonempty, explicitly admitted **terminal-child domain**. This closes a complete signed comparison beyond [PR #4172](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4172); it is not another native-component ratio or ledger with unexplained E1/E8/Delta_N prices.

The conclusion is scoped. Keep actual RootPlan fast entry, post-remainder e=73 lambda with d<=e^1000, the genuine C8 terminal predicate `8 lambda<73 OR (8 lambda)^1000<d`, physical H_b>=L^4, complete packet v>=2685, the certified positive-slope column threshold, and compatible admitted q/profile/program/capacity choices. Original source/numerical/hosting/stock/long-record premises remain. Forty exact production-descriptor certificates at p=2^8500 establish lambda=5..44 in this domain. Their enormous payloads were not executed.

**Stop expanding the fixed recovery in this proved band.** No verdict is claimed for nonterminal C8 calls, changed source-compatible demands/schedules, arbitrary compiled-control tariffs, total historical backing, all-node suppliers or kappa.

## What resolves the remaining prices

The actual source occurrence partition removes 32 centre-wrapper monomials,16 rank-eight children,8 private copies and 6 unit subtracts. The six subtracts match new identical-literal calls at the same full geometry. Monomials split at literal source call sites into equal setup/phase/return bases and exact completed gate atoms. Inverse reverses the word; it does not change a gate selector. [PR #4172](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4172) supplies successful-payload/closed-history equality only at matching full geometry.

The 736 old wrapper gates inject into 7150 fixed new gates except 4 Gamma add(6,8) and Gamma add(8,6). A new quantified finite-group result closes those deficits: every fixed 9x9 head has more than half its independent-bit mass in the complete O(73,2) cover, using64-coordinate tails and an explicit characteristic-vector exclusion. Leading-block events force each literal gate with frequency greater than Gamma/32. The 736 paid owner words supply more than 23 Gamma of each. Identity-owner witnesses are not extrapolated and no axis-cost invariance is assumed.

The complete terminal original C call, including descriptor/shape work, the paid capped-power cutoff, all coefficient axes, return, disposal and borrowed heads, has componentwise bound

    E_w <= 2^32(w+1)[v+(G_s+1)L^4] <= 2^33(w+1)v,
    G_s=v/(2H_b).

There are exactly zero descendants on this source branch. Added E1 calls have this same derived bound and are conservatively dropped as positive work in the exclusion. All removed 16 E8 calls use an UPPER bound. Eight copies and sixteen B external shells have separate source-derived upper debits; A's embedded parking is never used as avoided baseline work.

After matching the original two core bank cycles, actual candidate-only gathers and disjoint scatter appends give

    (R,W,M) >= (2,1,2)(281593/816) Gamma B_bank,
    B_bank=14336 Gamma v; service_bank=B_bank/32.

This is a literal source-action lower bound, not a diagnostic volume subtraction. Every other acquisition/compiler/service/scalar/map/publication/disposal/fence/setup term is matched, debited on the correct side, or retained nonnegative. Exchange-internal negations are not added twice.

## Complete fair-baseline certificate

Let a=(281593/816)*14336 Gamma and

    C(lambda)=16*2^33(8lambda+1)+8*2^22+16*2^26.
    s=(2a+5*510662-C, a+2*510662-C, 2a+4*510662-C).
    h=(12*510646+2*510662, 4*510646, 12*510646+2*510662).

The entire root comparison satisfies, componentwise:

    (T_D-T_B*)_i >= Gamma v s_i + Gamma h_i - 66496 > 0.

All 510646 Gamma retained bodies cancel under [PR #4172](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4172), including 6972 changed-core and 493097 later calls. Their14,298,088 Gamma header actions remain. B*'s established adoption saving is credited exactly once; frozen D gets no D* adjustment. The 703-write original-backend potential cancels once globally. The 66496 total B-controller startup/retirement upper is pessimistically subtracted in EACH coordinate.

The last positive column integer is derived explicitly, has 2610 bits, and passes an endpoint/next-integer check. It is a sufficient bound threshold, not a claim every geometry below it is reachable. For arbitrary positive action weights, exclusion holds in this source currency. Full compiled-step exclusion additionally requires signed control difference at least minus the weighted lower bound. Fixed inventories remain B/B*:678+M(q)+1023, D:conservative 678+3M(q)+2^20; historical per-role backing is separate and erasure does not reclaim it.

## Evidence and reproducibility

Scientific main12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244, priority 7. Retained [PR #4172](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4172) head59b46625a8b2f0dfff3e38ba0949b4247423938a; [PR #4167](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4167) head6749e458800f461535d64cc91c017552d9f55e5f; frozen [PR #4166](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4166) head0b082d22a0e9a442d264ab0633e35ef26c790630. All 108 nested-loader files authenticate before inherited execution. No cached foreign Git object is needed.

Reproduce:

    python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-complete-cost

Default fresh evidence includes17 exact countdown calibrations,7 complete selected C leaf executions,1 explicitly reduced-binding complete cutoff execution,3 encoded cutoff kernels,12 phase cases,3 complete bank cycles, literal O73 gate witnesses, full occurrence/later/service census,40 exact RootPlan geometries and independent signed/counting/schema controls. The optional6190-bit cutoff kernel was executed once (209.934s), not repeated by default and not represented as a width 73 payload run.

Fresh ordinary/optimised primary and six source/export/typed-receipt boundary groups passed. The full registered launcher passed, with six boundary groups in95.511 seconds. Committed-byte/source-history preflight passed 108 files at the exact publication head; the official 108-payload-file export/check passed. Actual committed read-only Git-free scientific replay results are recorded below. Archive SHA256 36ff7e1e6613a0669c1915428c0e7472f76babe1ad24740d3653242fe5a1f76c. Frozen16-file read-only adversarial review found no unresolved blocker; it independently reconstructed cover arithmetic and representative signs, inspected source interfaces, and ran fresh/check-only verification. Shared sources/checkers are disclosed; this is assisted review, not human/formal-kernel acceptance.

Publication head: 4cdda81c2ad99ffe5add0ac5d894094c3cca101a.

Nick Petalas/[PR #2982](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2982)/[PR #2951](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2951), commdata2338/[PR #3233](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3233), Ross Richardson/[PR #2831](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2831), Nick/[PR #2923](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2923) and Wentao Li/[PR #3993](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3993) retain their scoped method/backing credit. Arham/[PR #2877](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2877) and ywz65/[PR #2473](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2473) retain predecessor countdown credit. No BIT/ADD/wrapper coefficients are transplanted. Chris R/Clear1nsight with substantial coordinated OpenAI Codex assistance. Original notices retained.

The next discriminating domain is a genuinely nonterminal C8 call after the actual global height cutoff. It needs complete embedded descendant parking and candidate local/native prices. Width>=73 alone does not certify recursion. No additional decoder search is justified by this scoped result. Selected kappa is unchanged.

Committed scientific export replays both PASS: ordinary50.928s, optimised58.403s, empty stderr, Git absent, executable search path unavailable, and unchanged bytes/modes/mtimes/inodes. These reran all default physical calibrations from the exact committed108-file export plus manifest; check-only transport is separate. No scientific source changed after the frozen review and committed verification.
